body.description: UTF-8 byte bound is also enforced

QueueLimits.description: All values proposed local prototype limits. One tenant-wide default logical queue per project; no multiple-queue sharding.

token_sha256.description: SHA-256 of complete nonproduction rl_local.<tenant>.<key_id>.<secret> token. Server never receives raw secret in this body.

permissions.description: Input is normalized as a set; duplicate permissions are accepted and deduplicated.
